events.body:

C2: The higher-than-expected fare the rider complains of is explained by time, not distance: the trip took 22.0 minutes against an estimated 16.3 minutes (F2), and the metered time component billed was $5.72 for those 22.0 minutes (F5), in heavy rain of 18.5 mm with thundery showers during the trip (F11). The driver's statement that he followed the app route (F7) is not needed to establish anything, but it is consistent with the system record in F1 and F3, which is what governs; there is no in-app chat at all (F6), so no rider message exists that could show a route change was agreed, requested, or concealed.

The higher-than-expected fare the rider complains of is explained by time, not distance: the trip took 22.0 minutes against an estimated 16.3 minutes (F2), and the metered time component billed was $5.72 for those 22.0 minutes (F5), in heavy rain of 18.5 mm with thundery showers during the trip (F11).

The slow running was not attributable to the driver's chosen route: no traffic incident was recorded near the route during the trip window (F10), the only recorded congestion was band 3 (20-29 km/h) on the Pan Island Expressway and Airport Boulevard (F8, F9), and the rain was heavy (F11), which is why RD-4 (a) accident/roadwork-type justification does not arise and no segment is exempted on that basis either.
